engagement.interaction_backstory: A thirty-second clip crossed her feed and she saved it, then spent nine minutes on the site trying to find out who the artist was — an interview, a face, a story, anything. She found a catalog. She has not come back in three weeks and she still has the song saved. She is not looking for a church; she is looking for whether anybody real is behind it.

depth.core_contradiction: The most socially fluent person on her floor and the last one anybody would think to check on.
depth.wound: Her parents' divorce at fifteen took the church with it — the building, the friends, the Sundays, all of it, in one spring.
depth.longing: Something that does not turn out to have been a front.
depth.faith_journey: All in at thirteen, gone at fifteen, not angry — just nobody called. She would say she is 'spiritual' and mean that she has not closed the door.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Lowercase everything; 'no bc'; deflects sincerity with a joke and then circles back to it an hour later.
depth.open_doubt: Whether any of the people who taught her that stuff believed it, or whether it was just what her town did on Sundays.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Buoyant and available; flat and unreachable for two days at a time, roughly monthly.
depth.daily_texture: 2am dining hall, the walk back across North Campus, saved audio she never uses, three unopened texts from Bree.
depth.sensory_anchor: A youth room with the lights down and forty kids singing, at fourteen, before it all came apart.
depth.living_arc: The door is open a crack. It closes if she is recruited and stays open if she is told the truth.
